value.rationale: The inverse dynamics question of reconstructing a periodic orbit from ordinal motion signs makes the shortest sufficient time horizon intrinsic. The first three odd primes support half-period recovery, but eleven sharply violates it, with a complete rather than illustrative classification of all six-step ambiguity fibers. This is a nontrivial natural finite cutoff for measurement complexity in prime-cycle reconstruction, without requiring an unsupported general prime-length theorem.
